answers.falsifier: On akiendell teeth 1-6 pass and the live-ledger tooth prints a FAIL line containing UNRAN; on a Linux box all 7 pass or the live tooth reads UNRAN; with the stand-in restored to a bare shebang path, teeth 1-3 red on akiendell.
answers.from_idea: none, because measured 2026-11-23 by running ticket 15d5d434f336's proofs natively on akiendell; see CairnCommons/tickets/15d5d434f336-the-cc-device-names-its-host-through-the-system-device-s-host-tool.json
answers.how: Proof-only edit: the stand-in claude is launched as [sys.executable, stand_in] since a shebang file cannot execute on Windows; the live-ledger tooth raises 'UNRAN: ...' when the ledger or any poke is absent and stays a real red when pokes exist and none consume within 60 s; __main__ prints teeth through run_teeth.
answers.traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured) and Law 8 (a proof a hollow build couldn't pass): a proof that drives the wrong launcher or a shebang file on Windows measures the host, not the code; outline 9.4.8.1 (a tooth this host cannot run reads not-run, never red); outline 10.3.2.1 (superclaude is Python on every box)
answers.what: The proof test_an_idle_cc_session_is_told_it_has_mail.py runs its stand-in claude on Windows, and its live-ledger tooth reads UNRAN on a host with no live poke.

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-23: the stand-in claude is an extensionless Python shebang script, not a bash shim; Windows cannot execute it, so claude_runs.jsonl stayed empty and 3 teeth failed. The shim itself is fine.
